name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2015 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 20 ATT&CK for ICS techniques that ATT&CK lists for campaign C0028, the 2015 Ukraine Electric Power Attack by G0034 Sandworm Team on 23 December 2015, with ICS-CERT's alert for the dated events: VPN access with likely legitimate credentials, breakers opened through the operators' own ICS client software, corrupted serial-to-Ethernet firmware, scheduled UPS disconnects and the loss of power to about 225,000 customers. Revoked ids are given as their current sub-techniques through data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. No 2015 source prints an ATT&CK id. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2015.md. Scores: 100 the ATT&CK object prints the id.
